text.p: These are some of the leading stories in Kuwait's press on Monday. Reuters has not verified these stories and does not vouch for their accuracy.
- Cabinet approves formation of committee to combat narcotics.

- Parliament's legal panel approved on Sunday a bill to ban musical concerts. The bill requires approval by the full parliament before sending it to the Emir Sheikh Jaber al-Ahmad al-Sabah for ratification.

- Qatar, Iran discuss joint security arrangements in the Gulf, informed sources say. Qatar's Foreign Minister Sheikh Hamad bin Jassim bin Jabr al-Thani flew to non-Arab Iran on Saturday for talks with senior officials.

- MP Abdulla al-Naibari says state must issue a law to regulate spending from the Future Generations Fund, an overseas nest-egg designed to support the desert state when its main revenue earner, oil, runs out. The government has been accussed of drawing large amounts from the fund.
